result.summary: Rautio Plastics Oy shows a worsening payment pattern: settled invoices went from 4 days late to on-time to 9 days late, and now one open invoice (INV002195, €57,767) is 18 days past due. A single insurer (CL05) holds a €420,000 active credit limit on this buyer, with no diversification of risk. Given the escalating lateness trend, closer monitoring or a limit review is advisable.
